description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. The download page now supports favoriting resources with custom groups, group filtering, multi-select and one-tap batch download; a new resource pack management page supports enabling/disabling (writes options.txt), importing, renaming, multi-select deletion and search.
2. Long-press the version card on the main screen to open a quick version switch menu sharing a snapshot with the version list page; a one-time guide hint for tapping the card was added.
3. The skin model gained a 3D skin layer toggle (disabling it falls the second layer back to vanilla faces) and a body/leg separation toggle (the upper body then fits onto the legs).
4. Manage and setting page tabs now show icons; FCLTabLayout shows indicator arrows at the corresponding edge when it can scroll left/right.
5. The control converter added two-way mapping for swipe-chain linkage and joystick dead zone / forward-lock fields.
6. Fixed Cleanroom letter keys and chat input not working, crashes when saving imported controller JSON containing nulls, being unable to add keys after creating a new control group, and the source badge being squeezed out on long download/favorite list titles.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.下载页新增资源收藏，支持自定义分组、分组筛选、多选与批量一键下载；新增资源包管理页，支持启用/禁用（写 options.txt）、导入、重命名、多选删除与搜索
2.长按主界面版本卡片可弹出版本快速切换菜单，数据与版本列表页共享快照；新增点击版本卡片打开版本列表的引导提示（仅显示一次）
3.皮肤模型新增 3D 皮肤层开关（禁用时第二层回落原版面片）与身体/腿部分离开关（关闭后上身贴合腿部）
4.管理页与设置页 tab 添加图标；FCLTabLayout 可左右滑动时在对应边缘显示指示箭头
5.控件转换器新增滑动联动与摇杆死区/前进锁字段的双向映射
6.修复 Cleanroom 字母键与聊天输入失效、导入含 null 的控制器 JSON 保存时崩溃、新建控件组后无法添加按键、下载与收藏列表标题过长时来源徽标被挤出等问题
